sloka: सो ऽहं रिपुविनाशाय विजयायाविचारयन् ।स्वयमेव गमिष्यामि रणशीर्षं तदद्भुतम् ।। ६.५९.५ ।।।।
transliteration: so 'haṁ ripuvināśāya vijayāyāvicārayan ।svayameva gamiṣyāmi raṇaśīrṣaṁ tadadbhutam ।। 6.59.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "I shall go myself without thinking to that wonderful battle scene and put an end to the enemy and succeed."
